calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for The Wellness Company - TWC
calls.summary: The team is preparing to transition from an agency-managed Growth Book account to managing their own in-house account to expedite test deployment and enhance control. Concerns were raised regarding the feasibility of running two Growth Book accounts simultaneously on the same Shopify site, with Jake Heier agreeing to investigate potential risks. Initial technical support will be provided by Jake to assist with installation and onboarding, tapering off as the team gains self-sufficiency. The enterprise pricing model begins at $50,000 annually for 60 experiments, allowing unlimited user seats. Growth Book’s flexible analytics dashboards can be customized for various users, and new AI capabilities are being introduced to automate insights. Follow-up communication will address pricing details and support offerings.
calls.keywords: Growth Book, Enterprise Pricing, Experiment Quotas, Shopify Integration, Support & Onboarding, Analytics Customization
calls.action_items:
**Jake Heier**
Consult internal team about feasibility and risks of running two Growth Book accounts on the same Shopify website and provide confirmation to the client (10:00)
Provide detailed pricing breakdown including volume discounts for additional tests beyond five per month (07:22)
Confirm and clarify how paused and restarted tests count towards experiment quotas and communicate this to the client (07:51)
Explain support offerings and onboarding assistance relevant for initial setup and ongoing use to the client (09:00)
Prepare and send a formal comparison between Growth Book and Intelligence BWO platforms to highlight differences and advantages (16:40)
Provide information on analytics customization, dashboard building, and AI capabilities to demonstrate platform flexibility and automation (17:00)
Outline pricing and payment terms clearly in a recap email including annual upfront payment and contract considerations (22:50)
Set up and propose a trial environment with dedicated support channel for client hands-on exploration of Growth Book features (22:15)
Schedule a follow-up call to review trial plan, test cases, and support resources prior to trial start (22:50)
Send recap email including discussed items and confirm next steps with the client (23:00)

**Ginny Johnson, Miguel Jurado, Brijeta Parmar**
Discuss internally their schedules and decide on timing for the follow-up call after receiving the recap email (23:30)

calls.title: GrowthBook<>The Wellness Company - POC Planning Call
calls.summary: The call discussed The Wellness Company's goal to move from using an external agency (Power Digital) for A/B testing to an in-house solution with GrowthBook, focusing on features like traffic splitting, GA4 integration, and Snowflake connectivity to address pain points around slow support, data control, and limited experiment frequency. Key participants included Jake Heier (account manager), Logan Bates (technical support), Virginia Johnson and Miguel Jurado Arenales (marketing/analytics), Brijeta Parmar (development),
